changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add NA status to audit_trail.status check constraint for non-request type actions
changeSet.sql: -- Drop the old constraint first so updates can succeed ALTER TABLE audit_trail DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS audit_trail_status_check;

-- Create new constraint with NA included -- Valid statuses: NONE, OPEN, APPROVED, DECLINED, NA (for non-request actions like LOGIN, LOGOUT, PAYMENT, etc.) ALTER TABLE audit_trail ADD CONSTRAINT audit_trail_status_check CHECK (status IN ('NONE', 'OPEN', 'APPROVED', 'DECLINED', 'NA'));
